description: Describes one browser-loadable WASM canister: the WASM core plus the weight shards the page must download. Mechanics scaffolding — validation only, no real weights implied.

id.description: Stable canister id, e.g. "avatar-phone". Used in cache keys.

memory.description: Optional WebAssembly.Memory hints for the core.

version.description: Semver. Bumping the version busts the browser weight cache.

wasmSha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the exact WASM bytes. The worker refuses to instantiate on mismatch.

wasmUrl.description: URL of the WASM core. Absolute URLs must be https:, except plain http: on localhost/127.0.0.1 (dev only). Relative URLs are same-origin.

weights.description: Weight shards, downloaded in order. Shard granularity is the resume unit.

url.description: Shard URL. Same rule as wasmUrl: absolute must be https: except http: on localhost/127.0.0.1.

title: Capsula Canister Manifest
